This is retracted because it is not what the rule left open. The predecessor said the rule was defeated only by a region that reaches the private witness, and that the introspection tripwire was then the only guard left; ep11.review-independent.json IR-EP11-01 defeated it with a region that never touches the witness, and IR-EP11-02 defeated the tripwire itself with six spellings it does not enumerate. Both are rebuilt and executed here. Publishing a source scan as the sole guard for a class is what ep9.review-independent.json rejected one level down, and an enumeration of spellings is not a proof at either level. In this instrument the tripwire is NOT a scored guard, the class is published as a declared measured escape instead, and RX2c is measured on every run escaping the enumeration so that the enumeration's limitation is a number rather than a paragraph.
